# demdex.net
> Adobe Audience Manager’s data collection and identity synchronization domain used for audience segmentation, profile management, and partner integrations.

This domain is primarily used as an infrastructure endpoint for Adobe Audience Manager and Adobe Experience Cloud services rather than as a traditional browsable website. Relevant documentation is hosted on Adobe Experience League and related Adobe developer resources.

## Adobe Audience Manager Documentation
- [Audience Manager Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager): Entry point for Adobe Audience Manager product documentation and concepts.
- [Getting Started with Audience Manager](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager-learn/tutorials/overview): Introductory tutorials covering core Audience Manager workflows and terminology.
- [Audience Manager User Guide](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide): Main user documentation for traits, segments, destinations, and administration.
- [Audience Manager API Reference](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/api): Reference documentation for Audience Manager APIs and programmatic integrations.
- [Audience Manager Release Notes](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager-release-notes): Product updates, feature changes, fixes, and deprecation notices.
- [Audience Manager Tutorials](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager-learn/tutorials): Guided learning resources for implementation and usage.

## Data Collection and DCS Endpoints
- [Data Collection Servers Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/dcs/dcs-overview): Explains Audience Manager data collection servers and request handling.
- [DCS API Calls Explained](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/dcs/dcs-api-calls/dcs-api-calls): Details supported DCS request formats, parameters, and behaviors.
- [Inbound Data File Transfers](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/integration/sending-audience-data/batch-data-transfer-explained/inbound-data-transfer-overview): Describes batch onboarding methods for audience data ingestion.
- [Outbound Data File Transfers](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/data-export/data-export-controls): Covers export controls and outbound audience data delivery concepts.
- [UUIDs in Audience Manager](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/ids-in-aam): Explains Audience Manager identifiers, device IDs, and namespace usage.

## ID Synchronization and Identity
- [ID Synchronization in Audience Manager](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/ids-in-aam/id-sync): Describes syncing Audience Manager IDs with partner and customer identifiers.
- [Declared IDs](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/ids-in-aam/declared-ids): Explains authenticated identifiers and cross-device profile association.
- [Device Graph Options](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/cross-device-profiles/device-graph-options/device-graph-options): Reviews available device graph integrations for identity resolution.
- [Profile Merge Rules](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/profile-merge-rules/merge-rules-start): Describes profile stitching logic across devices and identifiers.
- [People-Based Destinations](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/destinations/people-based-destinations-overview): Covers activation workflows using hashed identifiers for people-based platforms.

## Destinations and Integrations
- [Destinations Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/destinations/destinations): Introduction to server-to-server, URL, and cookie destination types.
- [URL Destinations](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/destinations/create-destination/url-destination): Documents browser-based destination configuration and macros.
- [Cookie Destinations](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/destinations/create-destination/cookie-destination): Explains cookie-based partner integrations and syncing behavior.
- [Server-to-Server Destinations](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/destinations/create-destination/s2s-destination): Covers backend audience delivery to integrated platforms.
- [Destination Macros](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/destinations/destination-macros): Lists supported macros for dynamic destination URL construction.
- [Adobe Integrations with Audience Manager](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/integration/integration-with-experience-cloud): Describes Experience Cloud product integrations and shared services.

## Traits, Segments, and Modeling
- [Traits Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/traits/traits): Explains trait creation, qualification rules, and data signals.
- [Segments Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/segments/segments-purpose): Describes segment composition and audience qualification logic.
- [Signals, Traits, and Segments](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/signal-trait-segment): Clarifies relationships between incoming signals, traits, and segments.
- [Algorithmic Models](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/algorithmic-models/understanding-models): Introduces look-alike modeling and algorithmic audience expansion.
- [Segment Builder](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/features/segments/segment-builder): Documents the interface and logic for building audience segments.

## Implementation and Tags
- [Set Up Audience Manager](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager-learn/tutorials/web-implementation/set-up-audience-manager): Implementation tutorial for deploying Audience Manager on websites.
- [Experience Cloud ID Service](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/id-service/using/home): Documentation for Adobe’s shared visitor identification service.
- [Data Integration Library (DIL)](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/dil-api/dil-overview): Reference for the client-side library used with Audience Manager.
- [Adobe Tags Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/home): Documentation for Adobe tag management and deployment tooling.
- [Web SDK Overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/web-sdk/home): Modern Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK documentation for data collection.
- [Server-Side Forwarding](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/analytics/admin/admin-tools/server-side-forwarding/ssf): Explains forwarding Analytics data to Audience Manager.

## Privacy, Governance, and Security
- [Data Export Controls](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/data-export/data-export-controls): Describes governance restrictions for audience activation and sharing.
- [Privacy and Data Protection](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/overview/data-privacy/data-privacy): Covers privacy capabilities and regulatory support in Audience Manager.
- [GDPR in Audience Manager](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/overview/data-privacy/gdpr-data-privacy-requests): Explains GDPR-related access and deletion request workflows.
- [Security in Experience Cloud](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/core-services/interface/features/security/security): Adobe Experience Cloud security and access management documentation.
- [Regional Data Collection](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/user-guide/reference/dcs/dcs-region): Documents regional DCS endpoints and geographic routing behavior.

## APIs and Developer Resources
- [Audience Manager APIs](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager/api): Central reference for REST APIs and authentication requirements.
- [REST API Code and Examples](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/audience-manager-learn/tutorials/apis/understanding-rest-apis): Tutorials for working with Audience Manager APIs.
- [Adobe Developer Console](https://developer.adobe.com/console): Create and manage Adobe project credentials for API access.
- [Adobe APIs and SDKs](https://developer.adobe.com/apis): Directory of Adobe developer products, APIs, and SDK resources.
- [Experience Platform API Authentication](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/landing/platform-apis/api-authentication): Authentication guidance relevant to Adobe platform API integrations.

## Support and Product Information
- [Adobe Experience League](https://experienceleague.adobe.com): Main hub for Adobe product documentation, tutorials, and support resources.
- [Audience Manager Community](https://experienceleaguecommunities.adobe.com/t5/adobe-audience-manager/ct-p/adobe-audience-manager-community): Community discussions, troubleshooting, and implementation questions.
- [Adobe Status](https://status.adobe.com): Service health and incident reporting for Adobe cloud products.
- [Adobe Support](https://helpx.adobe.com/support.html): Access Adobe support channels and enterprise assistance resources.
- [Experience Cloud Products](https://business.adobe.com/products/experience-cloud/adobe-experience-cloud.html): Overview of Adobe Experience Cloud products and positioning.
